name: Roadrunner-M interceptor (Anduril)
description: Twin-turbojet reusable interceptor launched from a ground nest and managed through Lattice. Anduril publishes no range, speed, altitude or endurance figure: every number here is a planning figure.

seekerAcquisitionRangeM.note: Anduril publishes no seeker and no acquisition figure for Roadrunner-M. Not established by the public record.

lethalRadiusM.note: Class median of the one sourced interceptor warhead radius: the APKWS M151 burst radius of 10 m (lib-eagls). Anduril publishes neither a warhead mass nor a lethal radius for Roadrunner-M, so the class value stands in. A one-member median is thin; it is recorded as such so a later source replaces it cleanly.

guidanceNoiseM.note: Planning factor: 2 m 1 sigma terminal guidance noise for a proximity-fuzed interceptor. The one sourced member of the class, the semi-active laser APKWS at better than 1 m CEP, sits at the accurate end; this seeker's accuracy is not published.

maxFlyoutSpeedMps.note: Anduril publishes no range, speed, altitude or endurance figure for Roadrunner-M; every number in this file is a planning figure. Not established by the public record.

boostTimeS.note: No boost and no acceleration profile is published for Roadrunner-M. Not established by the public record.
